entities.summary: Jacques-André-Joseph Aved, also called le Camelot and Avet le Batave, was a French painter, renowned among the main Rococo portraitists in Paris during King Louis XV's reign. He painted among others the Ottoman Empire ambassador to France in 1742, Yirmisekizzade Mehmed Said Efendi.
